@graph.name: Imgflip Meme Generator API
@graph.description: REST API for captioning meme templates, retrieving popular meme formats, searching the meme library, auto-generating memes from text, and creating original AI-generated memes.

offers.name: Free Tier
offers.description: Access to get_memes and caption_image endpoints at no cost

offers.name: Premium Tier
offers.description: Unlocks caption_gif, search_memes, automeme, and ai_meme endpoints

itemListElement.name: Get Popular Meme Templates
itemListElement.description: Returns an array of popular meme templates with metadata

itemListElement.name: Caption Image
itemListElement.description: Adds captions to a meme template and returns the generated meme URL

itemListElement.name: Caption GIF
itemListElement.description: Adds captions to an animated GIF meme template (premium)

itemListElement.name: Search Memes
itemListElement.description: Searches over one million meme templates by keyword (premium)

itemListElement.name: Get Meme
itemListElement.description: Retrieves details for a specific meme template by ID (premium)

itemListElement.name: Automeme
itemListElement.description: Auto-generates a meme from a text phrase (premium)

itemListElement.name: AI Meme
itemListElement.description: Generates an original AI-powered meme with optional topic seed (premium)
